$comment: Machine-readable spec for the Railway template composer. Railway has no official template-spec file format; this mirrors the composer fields 1:1 so a human (or tool) can transcribe it exactly. Verified against upstream sources 2026-07-23.
name: Cloud Dev Box — VS Code (code-server)
shortDescription: VS Code in your browser with password auth, a persistent home directory, and git/Node 22 LTS/Python 3/build-essential preinstalled.

PASSWORD.description: Web IDE login password (auto-generated). Swap for HASHED_PASSWORD later — see SECURITY.md.

WORKSPACE_DIR.description: Default folder code-server opens; lives on the persistent volume.

volumes.$comment: Entire home dir of uid 1000: code, extensions (~/.local/share/code-server), config (~/.config/code-server), SSH keys, dotfiles. Entrypoint chowns the root-owned mount on boot.

deploy.$comment: Exactly 1 replica — code-server sessions and the volume are single-writer; never scale horizontally.

recommendedResources.$comment: Idles ~200-400MB; heavy builds want 2GB+/2vCPU. Enable App Sleeping to scale to zero when idle.

evidence: https://github.com/coder/code-server/blob/main/src/node/cli.ts — $PASSWORD and $HASHED_PASSWORD env handling; HASHED_PASSWORD precedence; CS_DISABLE_FILE_DOWNLOADS; CODE_SERVER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
https://github.com/coder/code-server/blob/main/ci/release-image/Dockerfile — Debian 13 base, coder uid 1000, NOPASSWD sudo, git/curl/openssh-client preinstalled, dumb-init, EXPOSE 8080
https://github.com/nodesource/distributions — Node 22.x LTS deb repo (Debian 13's own nodejs is 20.19.x, EOL April 2026)

reasons: Runs s6-overlay as root for the container lifetime; PUID/PGID model targets host bind mounts, irrelevant on Railway volumes
No auth at all if PASSWORD/HASHED_PASSWORD are unset (documented default) — a footgun for a public-domain template
sudo requires opt-in SUDO_PASSWORD and is unavailable in some of its modes; official image ships NOPASSWD sudo for uid 1000
Persistence split at /config with workspace at /config/workspace — less natural than a plain /home/coder
Community rebuild vs. official upstream image (upstream docs/env vars/healthz map 1:1 to the official image)
